send.detail: client message reached the host as seq 1

ack.detail: host acknowledged with seq 1; client outbox empty: true

read.detail: client sees its message as read after the host read marker

reply.detail: reply resolved to its target on the client

react.detail: reaction folded onto the target on the host, not a row

edit.detail: edited text shown on the host, original kept in the log

delete.detail: the row became a stub on the host

typing.detail: typing frame reached the host as an ephemeral; neither log grew by it

feeling.detail: squeeze reached the host at intensity 0.62, the number it was sent at

state.detail: mood: restless reached the host, so what one person says about themselves is legible on the other phone without either of them writing a sentence

voice_note.detail: voice blob and event reached the host

video.detail: video and poster blobs fetched by the client with the event

viewer.detail: full-resolution photo bytes on the other device hash to the same blob

draft_survival.detail: draft and pairing intact after the client process was closed and reopened

kill_mid_send.detail: host received it once, the retry did not duplicate it, the client learned its seq

offline_queue.detail: 26 events queued offline, all delivered on reconnect

reconnect_ordering.detail: client holds seq 1..175 gapless and monotonic after the gap

refusal_and_retry.detail: refused with "this phone is on an older version and cannot read that", kept out of the wire for a round, and delivered as seq 176 when the person asked for it again

pairing_refused.detail: after a second phone paired, the first says "the other phone does not know this pairing" rather than polling with a key the host has forgotten, and pairing again clears it

host_offline_outbox.detail: queued while the host was down; delivered when it came back with its sequence intact

tailscale.why_the_listener_is_loopback: a userspace tailscaled has no TUN device, so no tailnet address exists on any interface to bind; it takes the inbound tailnet connection itself and hands it to loopback on the same port. The socket is narrower than it would be on a phone, not wider. On a phone the address is real and the host binds it — tailnet_test holds that path, including that every non-tailnet address is refused.
